briefTitle: A Clinical Study of MK-1084 With Other Treatments for Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (MK-3475-01F)

typedChecks.sourceText: Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has provided tumor tissue for biomarker analysis from an archival sample or a newly obtained core or excisional biopsy of a tumor lesion not previously irradiated
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to undergo a biopsy procedure is a judgment-based criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection must have well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy (ART) per protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Well-controlled HIV status is a clinical judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a diagnosis of small cell lung cancer or, for mixed tumors, presence of small cell elements
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of small cell histology in mixed tumors is not a standard histology_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has clinically severe pulmonary compromise resulting from intercurrent pulmonary illnesses
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinically severe pulmonary compromise is subjective and investigator-assessed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication or previous history of inflammatory bowel disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active IBD or history of IBD is not a typed clinical check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has evidence of any leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal disease evaluation is imaging-dependent and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disorder or cerebrovascular disease prior to allocation/randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disorder is investigator-assessed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has one or more of the following ophthalmological conditions: a) Clinically significant corneal disease b) history of documented severe dry eye syndrome, severe Meibomian gland disease and/or blepharitis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ophthalmological conditions are evaluated via clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HIV-infected participants with a history of Kaposi's sarcoma and/or Multicentric Castleman's Disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific HIV complications are not standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days before the first dose of study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for a live vaccine is not a standard lab or simple typed exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immunosuppressive therapy washout and chronic steroid use are judgment-based.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Additional prior malignancy history is complex and investigator-assessed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has any history of interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis irrespective of steroid use or current ILD, or suspected ILD
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of ILD/pneumonitis is a complex clinical safety exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active infection requiring systemic therapy is clinically judged.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has not adequately recovered from major surgery or has ongoing surgical complications
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical recovery is a subjective clinical evaluation.
